name: inception-mcp
description: Read-only access to an Inner Range Inception security controller. Requires Inception firmware 7.3.0.8528 or later (REST API protocol version 18).
long_description: Connects Claude to an Inner Range Inception alarm and access controller over its local REST API. Read-only by design: it can list areas, doors, inputs and outputs with decoded states and query the review event log, but it cannot arm, disarm, unlock, toggle outputs or change configuration. **Requires Inception firmware 7.3.0.8528 or later (REST API protocol version 18).** The server checks this when it starts and will not run against older firmware.

tools.name: inception_get_system_info
tools.description: Controller name, serial number and REST API protocol version.

tools.name: inception_list_items
tools.description: Areas, doors, inputs or outputs with decoded current state.

tools.name: inception_get_events
tools.description: Query the review event log by time, category, event type or item.

tools.name: inception_list_event_types
tools.description: Look up review event type IDs by name.

inception_url.title: Inception controller URL
inception_url.description: Local address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50) or your SkyTunnel URL (e.g. https://skytunnel.com.au/Inception/IN12345678)

api_token.title: User API Token
api_token.description: From Inception: Users > (API user) > Credentials > User API Token. Give that user view-only permissions.
